description: Fetch one UNESCO Global Geopark's full record by ugg_id: its countries, designation year, transnational status, area and resident population as recorded, coordinates, UNESCO's introduction and description, its account of how the geopark sustains local communities, its own website, and its UNESCO page.

ugg_id.description: The geopark's ugg_id, such as EUFR10, from unesco_search_geoparks. Case and surrounding whitespace are ignored.

name: unesco_get_geopark

countries.description: Country display names aligned with country_codes.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the geopark's countries; a transnational geopark lists each.

designation_year.description: Designation year; geoparks UNESCO recognized before the Global Geopark label existed are dated 2015, the year it was created.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `geopark_not_found`: No record carries this ugg_id, after trimming and uppercasing. `snapshot_unavailable`: No geopark snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

population.description: Resident population, as recorded; absent when UNESCO records none, and 0 can mean unreported.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

sustaining_local_communities.description: UNESCO's account of how the geopark sustains its local communities.

transnational.description: True when the geopark spans more than one country.

website.description: The geopark's own website, when recorded.

title: Get UNESCO Global Geopark
